A listing whose WordPress minimum is not the one the plugin enforces.

== Description ==

The minimum lives in three places: this line, the "Requires at least" header of
the plugin entry point, and Constants::MINIMUM_WORDPRESS_VERSION, which is the
one that actually refuses to boot. Raising it here alone tells the directory to
hide the plugin from a WordPress the code still runs on, and lowering it here
alone invites an installation the code will refuse.

Everything else in this listing is coherent, so the report has to name these
three values and only these.
